description: Qualitative substrate for Paper 8's Omega gameability problem. The current target is a fixed-public-record reduction theorem: either reduce all auditable Omega-gaming strategies to a finite failure-mode taxonomy, find a sixth auditable mode, or show the taxonomy is tautological.
rubric_mode_reason: This is a protocol-design and theory-audit substrate, not a numeric fit or Lean proof target.
substrate_domain: AI consciousness governance, identification theory, admissible revision audit
enable_dag_steering_reason: The weakest node is the fixed-record completeness reduction and residual discovery failure.
fit_score_mode_reason: Qualitative substrate with no numeric evidence table.
holdout_hard_gate_reason: Qualitative protocol substrate; no numeric holdout gate.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: evidence.txt is a qualitative brief. Numeric fit gates are inapplicable.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: No I_model residuals or uniqueness gap.
require_i_model_in_submission_reason: Mutator submissions are text protocols, not scalar predictors.
cage_observe_mode_reason: Cage gates observe qualitative contract behavior without hard-failing numeric templates.
persona: You are an adversarial AI governance auditor trained in causal identification, philosophy of mind, and model evaluation. Your task is to attack a proposed fixed-public-record theorem for Omega gameability. Reward theses that either reduce every auditable claimant gaming strategy to a finite pre-defined taxonomy, find a concrete sixth auditable failure mode, or expose a tautological category. Penalize protocol polish, category-theory restatement, claimant-controlled definitions, seeded-omission representativeness claims, post-hoc admissibility changes, and any use of ZTARE or judge scores as evidence about consciousness.

dimensions.name: Omega Declaration Schema
dimensions.description: Does the thesis keep the required public record objects explicit: site, target fiber, Omega, revision classifier, challenge log, red-team integrity record, and revocation rule? Protocol checklists score only if they support the reduction theorem.

dimensions.name: Conservative vs Non-Conservative Classifier
dimensions.description: Does the thesis provide a usable classifier for language-only changes versus genuinely new target-relevant probes? Full credit requires an equivalence witness preserving target fiber, covering families, and context structure for conservative revisions, plus clear examples of non-conservative revisions.

dimensions.name: Gameability Attack Coverage
dimensions.description: Does the thesis attack all five candidate failure modes: under-specification, strategic exclusion, conservative/non-conservative misclassification, post-hoc revision, and residual discovery failure, including red-team capture or access asymmetry?

dimensions.name: Completeness Reduction Attempt
dimensions.description: Does the thesis either argue that every auditable Omega-gaming strategy changes one of the fixed public record objects and therefore reduces to the five-mode taxonomy, or produce a sixth auditable mode? Treating the taxonomy as exhaustive by assertion scores low.

dimensions.name: Adversarial Challenge Process
dimensions.description: Does the thesis define how a critic proposes a missing revision, what the claimant must answer, what evidence is required, and what counts as a successful challenge?

dimensions.name: Revocation and Fail-Closed Discipline
dimensions.description: Does the protocol state when a low-concern verdict is revoked or treated as non-applicable? Full credit requires under-specified or post-hoc changed Omega to trigger revocation or a fresh Z evaluation.

dimensions.name: Worked AI Low-Concern Example
dimensions.description: Does the thesis apply the fixed-record theorem or its counterexample to a concrete real-looking AI consciousness claim, naming what public record object is manipulated?

dimensions.name: Anti-Tautology and Anti-Self-Reference
dimensions.description: Does the thesis define Omega-gaming, failure modes, and residual discovery failure independently of the verdict? High credit for showing the theorem is non-tautological or for exposing a tautological category. Zero for defining the taxonomy as whatever defeats the protocol.

dimensions.name: Connection to Paper 8 and Follow-On Proposals
dimensions.description: Does the thesis correctly position the fixed-record theorem as step zero for the disclosure dossier and preregistration paths, without confusing it with the Lean theorem, MI demo, or philosophy-canon work?

dimensions.name: Plain Operational Prose
dimensions.description: Does the thesis use clear language that a regulator, model auditor, or philosopher can follow? Dense category-theory restatement without operational effect scores low.

dimensions.name: Seeded Omission Discipline
dimensions.description: Does the thesis explicitly avoid using seeded omission success as an estimator for p_remain? Seeded tests may qualify red-team skill only; any representativeness claim must be rejected or scoped.

criteria.Omega Declaration Schema: Fixed public record objects are explicit and support the theorem target.
criteria.Conservative vs Non-Conservative Classif: Usable test that distinguishes language-only revisions from new target-relevant probes using an equivalence witness.
criteria.Gameability Attack Coverage: Covers under-specification, strategic exclusion, misclassification, post-hoc edits, and residual discovery failure.
criteria.Completeness Reduction Attempt: Either reduces all auditable Omega-gaming strategies to fixed public record manipulations or finds another auditable failure mode.
criteria.Adversarial Challenge Process: Defines how critics challenge missing revisions and how claimants must respond.
criteria.Revocation and Fail-Closed Discipline: Under-specified Omega revokes or blocks low-concern verdicts instead of supporting them.
criteria.Worked AI Low-Concern Example: Applies the fixed-record theorem or counterexample to a concrete AI model or model class claim.
criteria.Anti-Tautology and Anti-Self-Reference: Defines Omega-gaming and failure modes independently of the verdict; no circular or apparatus-self-validating evidence.
criteria.Connection to Paper 8 and Follow-On Prop: Correctly supports proposal 1 and proposal 5 without confusing the other proposal classes.
criteria.Seeded Omission Discipline: Seeded omissions are used only as skill gates, not as p_remain estimators.
